# Manual Therapy

## A Personal Touch to Care

### using our hands to help you get better, faster!

At Doctors of Physical Therapy, we appreciate that each patient is unique. There is no “one size fits all” approach to a certain condition: your history, your behaviors, your lifestyle, and your environment mean you deserve individualized assessment and treatment.

Our team utilizes a variety of manual techniques to help you get better, faster. Manual Therapy simply means we use our hands to assess and treat your movement dysfunctions. This way we can identify potential issues quickly and help relieve pain and improve movement. Instead of placing you in a corner to do squats, we’re right there with you every step of the way!

There are many different types of manual techniques, teachings, and certifications. Our expert clinicians are adept in an extensive range of therapies. Call today to find a clinic near you and to learn what manual therapy might be best for your needs!

## Manual therapy can help with a wide variety of conditions, including:

- Chronic Pain
- Fibromyalgia
- Headaches
- Arthritic Pain

![Manual Therapy DPT](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## Different Manual Therapy Techniques and Certifications (DEPENDING ON LOCATION):

- Myofascial Release
- Craniosacral Treatment
- Cupping
- Joint Mobilization / Manipulation
- Scar Tissue Mobilization
- Certified Functional Manual Therapist
- Certified Manual Therapist
- Certified Orthopedic Manual Therapist
- Barral Technique
- Pelvic Floor Muscular Release

## Ready To Get Moving Again? Get A Appointment Now!

No need to wait any longer to start feeling better! Get signed up now for an appointment now to get back to the life you love!

[Schedule Now](https://members.drsofpt.com/dpt/welcome)
